notes:
A zone now reports what Sonos is playing, or says Unknown — never the last thing Sorriva played.

SONOS RADIO NAMES ITS STATION CORRECTLY. Start a station in the Sonos app and Sorriva follows it, instead of going on showing whatever it last played itself. Sonos Radio identifies a station in one place and the song in another, and Sorriva had been reading the song — so the station never matched, and a zone playing Brit Soul reported Cocktail Hour indefinitely. Logged as a bug on 4 August, fixed today with the root cause recorded then proving correct in full.

THE SONG, THE ARTIST AND THE COVER NOW COME FROM THE STREAM. Sonos Radio publishes all three per track, in a field Sorriva had deliberately stopped reading because for iHeart it holds a filename. Each service now says where its own now-playing lives, so both services get it right and a service nobody has taught us about keeps the behaviour that shipped.

UNKNOWN RATHER THAN WRONG. When Sorriva cannot identify what a speaker is playing it says so, and clears the artwork, instead of showing the last station it knew. The song and artist the stream reports still show — only the identity is withheld.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE: Sonos Radio's per-track artwork is built and unit-tested but was never seen on a live card. SiriusXM and Spotify still read Unknown when playing; each needs its own adapter, and SiriusXM's is next.
